snippet.title: Catchemist Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Catchemist: Brew the right potion is a physics-based cozy alchemy cleanup game enjoyable solo or co-op. 

Play as cutesy animals wielding magic wands, cleaning up 1000+ ingredients by levitating them through space, refine them at multiple processing stations, brew almost 200 unique recipes and place them into correct shelves to transform the laboratory into a place filled with harmony & peace.

Wishlist and play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5007680/Catchemist_Brew_the_right_potion/
